title: Display of Prices at Wet Market Stalls
what_it_is: Display of Prices at Wet Market Stalls

sections.label: Stallholder price display requirement
sections.summary: All stallholders must display prices under licence conditions, with price ranges allowed where fixed prices are not feasible, and NEA issued verbal advisories to over 110 market stallholders in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Currently, all stallholders are required to display their prices as part of their licence conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Where it is not feasible to indicate fixed prices, stallholders can also indicate a price range instead.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2016, in response to feedback, the National Environment Agency (NEA) issued verbal advisories to more than 110 market stallholders to display their prices and most of the stallholders had cooperated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: We recognise that many wet market stalls may face difficulty in displaying their prices as the prices of market produce may fluctuate on a daily basis and are currently looking into revising this requirement.

sections.label: Place managers at markets
sections.summary: Place managers are present at wet markets and hawker centres to monitor.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, at these wet markets and hawker centres, we do have place managers there to monitor.

sections.label: Price range for fluctuating produce
sections.summary: Stallholders selling market produce with daily fluctuating prices were advised they could display a price range to comply, and more outreach and education will be done through place managers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I had said, for some stalls, in particular, where they are selling market produce and if the prices fluctuate on a daily basis, it is quite difficult.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have engaged them and advised them that they could display a price range instead, which would also comply with the requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Clearly, we will do more, in terms of reaching out and educating them through our place managers, too.
